Usage: astryx integration [options] [command]

Author and verify an Astryx integration package

Options:
  -h, --help                   display help for command

Commands:
  add [options] <kind> <name>  Add one working contribution to an integration package
  check [options]              The CI check for an integration package's own build: every source check, run in continuous integration or a typecheck script, against the package in the current folder
  verify                       Check the package the way npm will publish it, before you publish
  pack [options]               Deprecated: the old name of `integration verify`

Exit codes:
  0  help is shown or a subcommand succeeds
  1  an unknown subcommand is provided

Examples:
  # Add a component
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 integration add component AcmeWidget
  # Check the package in CI, as part of its build
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 integration check --strict
  # Check the package before publishing
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 integration verify

More: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/commands/integration
